limitations: The native M1 host carried a 1-minute load average of 4.83 at campaign start, so sample spread remains broad (notably padded SPSC, 21M-54M) and the padding direction stays exploratory.
Linux-only placement cases were skipped on macOS; Linux evidence still rests on the 2026-08-22 pilot VM run.
No x86-64 performance sample was collected.
No perf counters were available, so retry counts and process rusage are not a decomposition into instructions, cache misses, or migrations.

m1_native.environment: Apple M1, Darwin 26.5.2, Apple Clang 21.0.0, 8 physical and 8 logical CPUs
m1_native.label: native hardware, scheduler-managed placement

method.affinity: scheduler-managed unpinned on macOS; Linux-only placements skipped
